entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something. I got this jersey, but it's... it's just not right. I tried looking on the website, but it was all so confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
A preference? I guess? I think I ordered the wrong size. It feels way too tight across the chest. I just don't understand all the charts and fits you have.
I see. So it sounds like you'd like to exchange it for a different size. I can definitely help with that. Can I get your order number to pull up the details?
Oh, an exchange would be great. The order number is... VF789012. I'm just so lost with this stuff. Can't you just help me? It's so much easier than clicking all those buttons.
Of course, that's what I'm here for. I see your order for the ClubFit Jersey, delivered five days ago. You're well within our 90-day return window for apparel, so an exchange is no problem at all.
Ninety days? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I missed a deadline. That's a huge relief.
Absolutely. It's a common issue when a jersey is too tight. Let's get you the right size. What size would you like for the exchange?
I think a Large would be perfect. The Medium was just... not happening.

Perfect. I've just initiated the exchange for a size Large. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid return label. Just print that out, attach it to the package with the original jersey, and drop it at any post office. Once we see the return has been scanned, we'll ship out your new one.
Wow, that's it? You made that so simple. Thank you so much, Sarah. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help!
Glad I could assist. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
